verdict.rationale: Docs describe Copilot's cloud/coding agent that can edit files, plan and execute tasks autonomously, and let users 'launch work from GitHub... review changes, and merge completed work,' implying it stages changes, commits, and opens PRs. However, no community/hands-on evidence in the pack specifically validates this PR-creation workflow, and older community comments focus only on code completion/chat, leaving the claim largely vendor-asserted.
